package repo

import "example.com/hypothetical/model"

func Find() (model.User, error) { return model.User{Name: "found"}, nil }
func Compatible() (model.User, error) { return model.User{Name: "compatible"}, nil }
func Single() model.User { return model.User{Name: "single"} }
func Pointer() *model.User { return &model.User{Name: "pointer"} }
func Pair() (model.User, error) { return model.User{Name: "pair"}, nil }
func Second() (model.User, bool) { return model.User{Name: "second"}, true }
func Reordered() (model.User, error) { return model.User{Name: "reordered"}, nil }
